description:
List every version Invokely has kept of a figure: each time the publisher revised it, or only changed its status (for example provisional to final).
Use it for "how was the August CPI revised", "has this figure changed since it was first published", or to audit a number used earlier. For the figure at one past instant, call get_value with as_of instead.
Pass period for one figure. Without period, or with from and to, it lists up to 60 periods with more than one version, newest first, and the summary (counts and largest_change) covers the whole range.
Example: {"indicator": "cpi_annual_change", "place": "Spain", "period": "2026-08"}.
Returns {indicator, place, frequency, periods: [{period, revisions, status_changes, confirmed_final?, first_value, latest_value, change, versions: [{version, value, status?, known_from, known_until, published?, source_url}], note?}], summary: {periods, periods_revised, revisions, status_changes, largest_change?}, vintage_coverage_starts?, truncated?, source}. revisions counts changes of the value; status_changes counts new versions with the same value and another status, and confirmed_final is when a provisional or estimated value became final unchanged. A value only confirmed as final was not revised; do not say it was. known_until is null for the current version; published is the publisher's own release time when known.
Versions start when Invokely first retrieved the series (vintage_coverage_starts); revisions the publisher made before that are not included. Cite source.citation.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code to disambiguate the place, for example "ES" or "US".

frequency.description: Optional. Force a frequency when the indicator exists in several (for example monthly and annual unemployment).

from.description: Optional first period of a range, inclusive.

indicator.description: Indicator id from search_indicators, for example "population", "registered_unemployment_rate", "unemployment_rate", "cpi_annual_change", "net_income_per_person".

period.description: Optional. One period to list every version of. Same formats as period in get_value.

place.description: Place name or id. Examples: "Mataró", "Barcelona", "provincia de Barcelona", "Cataluña", "España", "Germany", "EU", "es-mun-08121", "08121" (INE code), "ES51" (NUTS), "Texas", "Travis County, Texas", "us-county-48453", "fips:48453" (US county FIPS), "Austin, TX", "us-place-4805000", "fips:4805000" (US city GEOID).

to.description: Optional last period of a range, inclusive.

name: get_revisions
title: Get revision history
